Default Prove-Up Hearing
Off Calendar Mar-06-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Akele Atkins, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Ferguson Enterprises, Inc.
Trish Funk, credit manager for plaintiff, was placed under oath and testified.
No appearance by defendants Mark Wallace, a/k/a Mark Anthony Wallace, individually and as a partner in Mark's Plumbing of Porterville, and Kim D. Wallace, a/k/a Kimberly Wallace, individually and as a partner in Mark's Plumbing of Porterville.
Defaults were against defendants on 09/20/07.
Doe defendants were dismissed on 12/19/07.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants: Mark Wallace, a/k/a Mark Anthony Wallace, individually and as a partner in Mark's Plumbing of Porterville and Kim D. Wallace, a/k/a Kimberly Wallace, individually and as a partner in Mark's Plumbing of Porterville as follows:

Damages/Principal - $33,782.91.
Prejudgment Interest - $8,607.35.
Attorney's Fees - $3,752.50.
Costs $433.48, for a total of $46,576.24.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
